description.zh:
业务类型代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，查询全部传all。

代码详情请参见[通用字段参考](~~151572~~)。
description.en:
The business type code. Separate multiple codes with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all business types.

For more information about codes, see [Common field reference](~~151572~~).

description.zh: 搜索传入的内容，如果为空显示全部。
description.en: The content to search for. If this parameter is left empty, all results are returned.
